clue.text: Girl's report to paper gets the date wrong

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the girl's title is taken by its sound alone

parts.note: a girl is a miss, the title for an unmarried young woman
The Times is the national newspaper this puzzle appears in

explanation.surface: A girl's report sent to the newspaper has the wrong date on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'report' says the word for a girl (MISS) is wanted only as heard, written MIS.
explanation.definitionFit: To misjudge when something happens is to put it at the wrong moment, here the wrong day.

clue.text: Bad feeling I found over the West End in the fifties

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the single letter sits above the rest
in means the London district is put inside the run of fifties

parts.note: L is fifty in Roman numerals, so several fifties are a run of Ls, here four
W1 is the postcode of London's West End, read as the letters WI

explanation.surface: Someone sensed hostility over London's West End during the 1950s.
explanation.walkthrough: W1 is the postcode for London's West End shopping and theatre district; read as WI, it sits between two pairs of Ls.
explanation.definitionFit: Hostility or animosity towards someone is a bad feeling.

clue.text: As a statesman, one's closest to the Victorians

definitions.text: As a statesman, one's closest to the Victorians

parts.words: As a statesman, one's closest to the Victorians
parts.note: read statesman as a state's man, a man of an Australian state; Victorians are people of the state of Victoria, and the island state across the Bass Strait is nearest

explanation.surface: A politician who is closest in spirit to nineteenth-century people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Victorians' suggests the era of Queen Victoria; it means people of Victoria, the Australian state.
explanation.definitionFit: An islander from the Australian state just south of Victoria lives nearer to Victorians than any other state's people.

clue.text: Bird produced by magician

definitions.meaning: the wizard of King Arthur's court

explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs to a small falcon and to the wizard of Arthurian legend.

clue.text: Man on MCC side Don ordered to be vice-captain, perhaps

indicators.note: ordered means the given letters are put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A cricketer on the MCC team, Don, is told to act as vice-captain.
explanation.walkthrough: The MCC is the Marylebone Cricket Club; 'ordered' rearranges all of MAN ON MCC SIDE DON.
explanation.definitionFit: A vice-captain is an example of a deputy, the person next in authority.

clue.text: Instruct a lot of swimmers

definitions.meaning: a large group of fish swimming together

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for teaching and the collective noun for a shoal of fish.

clue.text: Given a turn to go first, went in front

parts.note: to start is to go first, to begin
led means went ahead of the others

explanation.surface: Someone allowed a turn to begin then took the lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Given a turn' sounds like taking turns in a game, but means given a fright.
explanation.definitionFit: To be given a turn is to be given a shock, which is to be alarmed suddenly.

clue.text: Work hard with author to create tragic heroine

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
Elia was the pen name of the essayist Charles Lamb

explanation.surface: A writer works hard to produce a tragic heroine.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamlet's drowned beloved is one of Shakespeare's tragic young women.

clue.text: Glaswegian, for one, less happy about the country

indicators.note: about means the word for less happy goes around the word for country

parts.note: lower means more downcast, less happy
land means a country

explanation.surface: A Glasgow man feels gloomier about his homeland.
explanation.definitionFit: Glasgow lies in Scotland's southern lowlands, so its people are an example of southern Scots.

clue.text: Shutter needs to be more tight

definitions.meaning: comparative of close, meaning tighter or nearer

explanation.definitionFit: One who shuts things fits the first sense; the comparative of close, as in a tight fit, fits the second.

clue.text: Watch host, mostly, shaping this

indicators.note: shaping means forming the given letters into a new arrangement
mostly means most of the word host is used, its final letter dropped

explanation.surface: Viewers watch a presenter who largely shapes the programme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the T from HOST; 'shaping' rearranges WATCH plus HOS. The whole clue also describes the answer: a programme you watch, shaped by its host.
explanation.definitionFit: A television talk programme is something you watch, guided by its presenter.

clue.text: Back I strain if taking on particular thing

indicators.note: back means the run of words before it is read from end to start

parts.note: to tax is to put a strain on

explanation.surface: Someone straining backwards takes on a particular task.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' turns the whole run I + TAX + IF, giving FIXATI; 'taking' then adds ON at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: An obsession is a particular thing one cannot stop thinking about, as in having a thing about something.

clue.text: Female characters in Hamlet

indicators.note: the characters, meaning letters, in the play's title are rearranged

explanation.surface: A question about the women who appear in Shakespeare's tragedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters in' looks like theatre roles but means letters: rearrange those of HAMLET.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a woman's first name, so it stands for a female.

clue.text: Done in Los Angeles, in evil surroundings

indicators.note: surroundings means the word for evil is placed around the city's letters

parts.note: evil means sin

explanation.surface: Someone was murdered in Los Angeles amid wickedness.
explanation.definitionFit: Done in is slang for killed, the same as murdered.

clue.text: Protect from eg fraud as organized

indicators.note: organized means the letters are rearranged into order

explanation.surface: Defend against fraud, for example the organized kind.
explanation.definitionFit: To shield or guard something is to protect it.

clue.text: Hothead in Passion play

parts.note: passion means fire, as in ardour
Brand is a verse play by Henrik Ibsen

explanation.surface: A short-tempered actor appears in a Passion play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Passion play' suggests a religious drama about Christ; here it is two words, and the play is by the Norwegian dramatist Ibsen.
explanation.definitionFit: An agitator or rabble-rouser is a person whose temper runs hot.

clue.text: Move pieces around in back rank

parts.note: rear means back
a range is a row or rank

explanation.surface: A chess player shuffles the pieces on the back row.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back rank' suggests the row of pieces at the rear of a chessboard, which suits the surface of shuffling chessmen.
explanation.definitionFit: To shift items into a new order is to reorder them.

clue.text: Southern racists Scots group reported

indicators.note: reported means the words for the Scots group are heard, not written

parts.note: members of a Highland family group

explanation.surface: A news item about bigots from the American South and a Scottish group.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ku Klux Klan is a white-supremacist group in the American South; its members sound like members of Scottish clans.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the Ku Klux Klan are white supremacists from the American South.

clue.text: Old weapon makes pirate secure

parts.note: Captain Flint is the pirate in Treasure Island
to secure is to lock

explanation.surface: An antique gun is what keeps a buccaneer safe.
explanation.definitionFit: A musket fired by a spark struck from a stone is an antique firearm.

clue.text: State elected divine female

parts.note: a candidate who is elected is in
Diana is the Roman goddess of the hunt

explanation.surface: A chosen goddess is announced for a territory.
explanation.definitionFit: It is one of the states of the USA, in the Midwest.

clue.text: Asian tribesman so long associated with king

parts.note: so long and ta-ta both mean goodbye
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A nomad from Asia bids farewell in the company of a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a Turkic people of central Asia and Russia is an Asian tribesman.

clue.text: In a current stoppage, worker is intransigent

parts.note: a dam stops the current of a river
the worker ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: During a power cut, an employee refuses to budge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current stoppage' looks like a power cut; it is a barrier on a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unyielding and refusing to compromise is firmly resolved.

clue.text: County work-forces

definitions.meaning: the short form of Staffordshire, an English county

explanation.definitionFit: Staffordshire is a county in the English Midlands, abbreviated this way; employees are personnel, here plural.

clue.text: Judge one of those responsible for hotel bookings?

definitions.meaning: a judge of Israel in the Old Testament who defeated the Midianites

definitions.text: one of those responsible for hotel bookings?
definitions.meaning: a member of the society that places Bibles, that is books, in hotel rooms

explanation.definitionFit: The biblical judge's name was taken by the Christian society that leaves Bibles in hotel bedrooms.

clue.text: It's habit-forming — that's relevant

definitions.meaning: cloth that forms a habit, a nun's or monk's robe
pertinent, as in evidence that bears on a case

explanation.definitionFit: Fabric is what a monk's habit is made from, and evidence that matters to a case is pertinent.

clue.text: Intended with accountant to back the world of learning

indicators.note: to back means the words for intended and accountant, in clue order, are read from end to start

parts.note: intended means aimed
ACA stands for Associate Chartered Accountant

explanation.surface: An accountant was meant to support the academic world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to back' turns the whole run of both words; the accountant's three letters form a palindrome, so only the word for intended visibly changes.
explanation.definitionFit: Universities and scholars together make up the scholarly community.

clue.text: In the end I placed ornament on top

indicators.note: in, with placed, puts the single letter inside the word for the end
placed, with in, means the letter is set inside the other word

parts.note: the final is the last stage, the end

explanation.surface: Finally, I put a decoration on the top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the end I placed' reads as 'I placed in the end': I goes inside FINAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorative knob on top of a spire, gable or bedpost is a crowning ornament.

clue.text: Fierce type means to continue tediously

definitions.meaning: a fearsome person, especially a forbidding woman
to go on and on boringly

explanation.definitionFit: A fire-breathing monster names a fearsome person, and split in two the word says to go on wearisomely.

clue.text: Information store I tested, perhaps, holding about a thousand words

indicators.note: holding about means the rearranged letters wrap around the letter for a thousand
perhaps hints that the letters given may be arranged in another way

parts.note: K is short for kilo, a thousand

explanation.surface: I tested a storage device holding around a thousand words.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges I TESTED; 'holding about' puts K inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A floppy disk is a small medium for storing computer data.
